one_liner: Open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin with a REST API for store data.
access_notes: Merchant generates consumer key/secret in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API; no developer program, per-store credentials.
mcp_note: WooCommerce core product/order abilities exposed via WordPress MCP Adapter plugin (default-enabled from WooCommerce 11.3); vendor-published, runs per store.
blocker_note: Self-hosted per-store; each merchant must supply site URL and keys, HTTPS and pretty permalinks needed.
